info.name: Task Management API
info.description:
REST API for the Task Management System (Laravel + MySQL).

Authentication uses Laravel Sanctum SPA cookies: the collection first calls `/sanctum/csrf-cookie`, then registers a fresh user (session cookie stored in the cookie jar). A collection-level pre-request script sends the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header and the `Origin`/`Referer` of the trusted SPA origin.

Run the requests in order. Set `appUrl` (default `http://localhost:8000`), `baseUrl` (`{{appUrl}}/api`) and `spaOrigin` (`http://localhost:4200`).

exec: // Sanctum SPA: identify as the trusted frontend and send the CSRF token captured from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie.
// Laravel refreshes the XSRF-TOKEN cookie on responses; keep the latest value.
